titulo: ChatGPT’s ‘Intelligent UI’ update fills its responses with pictures, charts, and buttons
cuerpo: OpenAI is launching a new Intelligent UI feature in ChatGPT that allows the chatbot to answer your questions with interactive visuals. The update, which is rolling out to all users alongside GPT-6, gives ChatGPT the ability to combine a text response with diagrams, charts, forms, tappable buttons, and more.
